description: Creates an inactive email automation. Pick trigger_tag from segments_list. Pass new_group: true only if the person explicitly wants a new group. If the API suggests a group name, ask the person which group they meant. Requires API key scope: draft.

new_group.description: Set true only when the person explicitly asks for a new group.

body.description: Plain text. Blank lines make paragraphs. Hollerpost adds the brand header, address and unsubscribe link.

delay_hours.description: Hours after joining the group for the first step, or after the previous step.

skip_if_opened_prev.description: Skip this step if the previous email was opened. Defaults to false.

trigger_tag.description: Use the exact tag from segments_list.

name: automation_draft
title: Draft automation
